# Designit

> A global, research-led product design studio. Designit grounds every decision in user research, then designs high-conversion UI/UX, branding, and product experiences for B2B SaaS, Fintech, EdTech, and enterprise software companies across the USA, UAE, UK, and India.

## What is Designit?

Designit is a research-led product design studio based in Noida, India, serving clients worldwide. Every engagement starts with user research and UX discovery before any interface is designed — decisions are grounded in real user behaviour, not guesswork.

Designit is not a generalist studio. It focuses exclusively on:
- B2B SaaS UI/UX design (dashboards, onboarding flows, design systems)
- Product design for mobile and web applications
- Brand identity and visual identity for tech startups
- Conversion rate optimisation (CRO) for landing pages and marketing sites
- Fintech & Web3 UX design (payment flows, trading platforms, wallets)
- EdTech platform design (learning apps, test engines, live class interfaces)
- Luxury real estate & PropTech digital experiences
- Automotive HMI and in-car infotainment design

## Approach

Designit follows a research-first methodology: user research and UX discovery, then design, then measurable growth. Every project is led by senior designers from kickoff through final developer handoff — no account managers, no junior hand-offs, no offshore layers.

## Our Team

Designit is led by a senior design team with 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS and e-commerce conversion design. Clients work directly with senior designers throughout.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sahilnsharma

## Industries Served

Designit has deep domain expertise across six sectors:

1. **B2B SaaS & Enterprise** — Complex dashboards, workflow tools, CRM platforms, and API management products. Key clients: Betacrew, Kelp Global.
2. **EdTech & Digital Learning** — Learning platforms, test series engines, live class interfaces, and performance analytics. Key clients: Adda247, StudyIQ.
3. **Fintech & Web3** — Payment flows, investment platforms, digital wallets, KYC flows, and trading dashboards. Regulatory-aware design for India, UAE, UK, and US.
4. **Luxury Real Estate & PropTech** — Immersive digital platforms for premium properties. Key clients: Rcentric (Omniyat, LIV Residences, Orla Infinity, Opus).
5. **E-Commerce & Digital Retail** — Purchase journey optimisation, PDP design, checkout flows, and retention experiences.
6. **Automotive & Smart Mobility** — HMI systems and digital instrument clusters for connected vehicles. Key clients: Tata Elxsi.

Industry detail pages: https://designit.co.in/industries/

## Clients and Case Studies

Designit has delivered measurable results for:

- **Adda 247** — India's largest competitive exam platform. Complete UI/UX transformation across test series, live classes, performance analytics, community features, and cross-platform expansion.
- **Betacrew** — Technology startup. Product design for Portle, a unified workspace tool.
- **Kelp Global** — PropTech / real estate. Designed the Deals Module, Kelp Plugin, and TrueNorth advisory platform.
- **Rcentric** — Luxury real estate. UI/UX for premium property brands including Liv, Orla Infinity, Opus, Vela Viento, and ANWA Aria.
- **Tata Elxsi** — Automotive HMI. Designed in-car infotainment systems and digital instrument clusters.
- **Omniyat** — Ultra-premium Dubai real estate developer.

## Services

Designit offers seven core service lines:

1. **UI/UX Product Design** — End-to-end product design from research to high-fidelity UI for web and mobile platforms.
2. **Design System Development** — Scalable, documented design systems with component libraries and design tokens.
3. **SaaS Strategy & Consulting** — Growth experiments to complete product overhauls, backed by data.
4. **UX Research & Discovery** — User interviews, journey mapping, usability testing, and data synthesis.
5. **UX Design Audit & Analysis** — Comprehensive audit with prioritised recommendations to improve conversions and retention.
6. **Digital Prototyping & Validation** — Interactive prototypes and live demos to validate before development.
7. **Digital Branding & Identity** — Visual identity systems, brand guidelines, and marketing asset production.

## Engagement Models

- **Design Sprint** — Fixed-scope deliverable (landing page, dashboard, brand identity). Delivered in 5 business days.
- **Monthly Retainer** — Ongoing design partnership. One active request at a time, 24-hour response time, direct senior-designer access, NDA on request, source Figma files included, 14-day post-handoff support.
- **Full Product Design** — End-to-end product design from research through to design system and handoff.

To get a tailored quote: https://designit.co.in/contact

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Designit's approach to product design?**
Designit is a research-led product design studio. Every engagement starts with user research and UX discovery before any interface is designed, so decisions are grounded in real user behaviour. Projects are led by senior designers throughout.

**How much does Designit charge for UI/UX design?**
Designit offers three engagement models: project-based fixed pricing (5-day sprints), monthly retainers (typically ₹1.5L–₹4L/month), and full product design engagements (4–12 weeks). Contact us at https://designit.co.in/contact for a tailored quote within 24 hours.

**How long does a typical project take?**
A Design Sprint is delivered in 5 business days. A full product design engagement typically runs 4–12 weeks depending on scope.

**Does Designit work with international clients?**
Yes. Designit works with clients in India, the US, the UK, and the UAE. All client communication is in English. Invoicing in INR or USD.

**What tools does Designit use?**
Primary design tool: Figma. Prototyping: Figma / Protopie. Handoff: Figma Dev Mode. Research: Maze, Hotjar. Project management: Notion / Linear.

**Which industries does Designit specialise in?**
Designit has deep expertise in B2B SaaS, Fintech & Web3, EdTech, Luxury Real Estate, E-Commerce, and Automotive HMI design. See https://designit.co.in/industries/ for sector-specific case studies and approach.
